headline: Genesys International Corporation Limited: Allotment of 25,074,226 Securities pursuant to Rights Issue
sum: Genesys International completed allotment of 25.07 million securities under a rights offering, marking the subscription and capital raise phase of the issue.
implication: Rights issue allotment triggers compliance with listing rules on disclosure timing, escrow arrangements and start of trading eligibility - critical for locked-in shareholder settlement and market opening schedules.
detail: Genesys International Corporation Limited has allotted 25,074,226 securities pursuant to a rights issue, as notified to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The allotment represents the completion of the subscription phase following the rights offer announcement. This step precedes commencement of trading and marks the point at which allottees' beneficial ownership vests, triggering escrow release timelines and market-opening conditions under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
